name: Spending Time With God
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of intentionally spending time with God through prayer, meditation, and Scripture. The psalmist models this by meditating on God throughout the night and hiding God's word in the heart to avoid sin. Jesus teaches believers to seek private communion with the Father in prayer and to prioritize God's kingdom above all else, warning against divided loyalties. God's word serves as a guiding light, illuminating the believer's path as they seek to serve Him wholeheartedly.
